findings.title: Long-list surface without pagination or windowing (endless-scroll risk)
findings.detail: The expected marker for this check was not found anywhere in the surface.
findings.fix: This surface can render a long list. Add pagination or windowing (like BooksTransactions' pageSize=25 + page controls) so it never becomes an endless scroll — consumer-familiar and mobile-tidy. If the list is provably bounded-small, add the surface to this check's excludeSurfaces with a note.
